interpretation: Pooled AR(k) R² is the held-out fraction of Δ_ℓ variance (beyond the per-depth mean μ_ℓ) explained by the k preceding updates; a single kernel is shared across depth, so a high value is jointly consistent with H1 and approximate AR-stationarity. The Granger grid is the per-(depth,lag) nested-F that localises how far back the dependence reaches and is the stationarity-free read. Null 1 (scrambled per depth) must collapse both.
